name: Maria Kairouz
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Maria Kairouz is psychotherapist and founder of wholesense. She works with individuals, couples, and families using a trauma-informed, attachment-focused approach that integrates Schema Therapy, CBT, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Polyvagal Theory, and somatic practices. Maria has a special interest in trauma, relationships, domestic and family violence, neurodiversity, and emotional wellbeing.

name: Megha La Peyre
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: Meghan is an ACA Registered Level 3 Counsellor and Clinical Supervisor and a member of the ACA College of Supervisors , providing professional supervision to counsellors, psychotherapists and other allied health professionals. With extensive experience across counselling, clinical practice and business, Meghan brings a warm, approachable and practical approach to supervision. She is passionate about creating a supportive space where practitioners can reflect on their work, build clinical confidence, navigate challenges and continue to grow both personally and professionally.
